subject: Next steps & kickoff: TideWave POC success criteria and cadence
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Maggie Chen <maggie.chen@tidewave.com>, Eric Liu <eric.liu@tidewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps & kickoff: TideWave POC success criteria and cadence

Thanks again for the call this morning — great alignment on scope. Quick recap + proposed plan so we all have the same page. Please review and confirm or flag any changes.

Recap (from our discovery)
- Goal: Validate that Redwood inference reduces per-request latency for TideWave search reranks by >=40% at 95th percentile while preserving baseline relevance (top-5 click-through delta <= 3%).
- Primary success criteria: latency SLO, relevance regression tolerance, and integration readiness (SSO + data access).

Proposed trial/eval plan (high level)
1) Kickoff & access week — alignment, production-like dataset handoff, and SSO setup.
2) Week 1 — initial integration, baseline runs, config tuning.
3) Week 2 — workload tuning, caching/batching experiments, and quantization trial.
4) Week 3 — acceptance testing, guardrail checks, and stakeholder readout prep.
5) Final readout — 30–45 minute presentation of results + next-steps recommendation.

Tentative timeline
- Kickoff window: week of Aug 14 (you mentioned internal constraints) — propose Aug 14 10:00am PT for 60m.
- Weekly check-ins: Thursdays 9:30am PT (30m).
- Final readout: Aug 31 (end of trial week) — 11:00am PT (45m).

Ownership (initial)
- Redwood: Monica (sales lead), Marissa (CS lead), Chloe (solutions engineer), Aditya (security/compliance).
- TideWave: Maggie (product sponsor), Eric (engineering PM).

Immediate asks / next steps
- Maggie/Eric: confirm kickoff date Aug 14 or propose alternate week. Confirm primary stakeholders and whether the dataset can be shared to the Drive link below.
- TideWave security: provide SSO/SCIM contact and list of domains for allowlist.
- Redwood: we will circulate a short mutual action plan and a success-criteria workbook (attached).

Attachments: TideWave_Success_Criteria.xlsx, Mutual_Action_Plan_TideWave.pdf (draft), SOW_Draft_TW-005.docx (outline).

Thanks — plan to lock timeline once I hear back from you.

—
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Maggie Chen <maggie.chen@tidewave.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Liu <eric.liu@tidewave.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & kickoff: TideWave POC success criteria and cadence

Monica — thanks for the summary, this is very helpful. We want to run with the plan but need to push the kickoff one week due to a scheduled data infra freeze the week of Aug 7. Can we target Aug 14 for the kickoff (10:00am PT works for us)?

Stakeholders:
- Maggie Chen (product sponsor)
- Eric Liu (engineering PM) — primary technical contact for data access and infra
- Priya Sinha (data infra) — will handle dataset exports and onboarding
- Jordan Park (security) — will own SSO/allowlist and compliance questions

On SSO: Jordan will need the SAML metadata and a short threat model. We also need clarification on whether Redwood requires user-level logs or just audit logs for the POC.

I see the draft SOW — we'll review and get back with comments. I can upload a sanitized sample dataset to the drive link by Jul 26.

—Maggie
Product Director, TideWave
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Maggie Chen <maggie.chen@tidewave.com>, Eric Liu <eric.liu@tidewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & kickoff: TideWave POC success criteria and cadence

Thanks — Aug 14 10:00am PT is confirmed on our side. I've sent a calendar invite to the listed stakeholders and attached an updated kickoff agenda + MAP.

Clarifications on logs: for the POC we only require aggregated audit logs (request id, timestamp, route) — we will not request user-level content. Aditya, please confirm security checklist items below and I'll share with Jordan.

Updated timeline (locked):
- Kickoff: Aug 14, 10:00am PT (60m) — agenda attached.
- Weekly syncs: Thursdays 9:30am PT (30m) — Aug 17, 24, 31.
- Final readout: Aug 31 11:00am PT (45m).

Deliverables before kickoff (due Jul 26)
- TideWave: sample dataset uploaded to shared Drive folder (Maggie).
- TideWave: SAML metadata + contact for SSO (Jordan).
- Redwood: final success-criteria workbook and runbook (Monica/Marissa).

I'll attach the SOW draft (SOW_Draft_TW-005.docx) and include DocuSign link once TideWave signals legal is ready.

On ownership: Marissa — would you own the runbook + acceptance rubric? Chloe — you'll prepare an inference configuration plan and a short demo checklist. Aditya — I'll loop you into Jordan's thread for SSO/compliance.

—
Monica
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: TideWave POC — owners & pre-kickoff tasks

Team — following TideWave confirmation (see quoted thread below), assigning owners and immediate pre-kickoff deadlines so we don't scramble in Aug. Keep replies short and confirm when you take ownership.

Owners & tasks
- Marissa Cole (CS lead) — create runbook + acceptance rubric; consolidate success-criteria workbook; due Jul 26.
- Chloe Martin (Solutions Eng) — inference config plan (models to test, quantization profiles, batching strategy) + demo checklist; due Aug 7.
- Aditya Rao (Security) — SSO/SAML checklist, data handling note, and the minimum logs spec to share with TideWave security; due Jul 22.
- Monica Patel (Sales) — finalize MAP and SOW follow-up; coordinate DocuSign when legal ready.

Risks to flag early
- Dataset sensitivity — if the sample contains PII we'll need a sanitized extract and an updated data retention note.
- Key stakeholder bandwidth during the freeze week — we have the kickoff week of Aug 14 to mitigate.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_TideWave.pdf (draft), TideWave_Success_Criteria.xlsx (template).

Please ack and update the shared Drive folder with your drafts under the TideWave POC folder.

—Monica
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Maggie Chen <maggie.chen@tidewave.com>, Eric Liu <eric.liu@tidewave.com>

Date: 2028-07-21T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & kickoff: TideWave POC success criteria and cadence

Maggie/Eric — thanks, the kickoff invite and agenda are in your calendars. I've attached a short kickoff agenda + acceptance rubric (Kickoff_Agenda_TideWave.pdf) for review ahead of Aug 14. Highlights:

- Day 0 (kickoff): alignment on dataset, success criteria walk-through, SSO next steps, run-of-show for first integration demo.
- Week 1 checkpoints: health check + baseline numbers, initial tuning experiments.
- Acceptance gate: 95th percentile latency improvement target + no more than 3% top-5 relevance delta.

Action items for TideWave before Jul 26:
1) Upload sanitized sample dataset to the shared Drive folder.
2) Share SAML metadata and security contact (Jordan).
3) Confirm whether TideWave legal wants the SOW routed via DocuSign (I can trigger once we have sign-off).

If that timeline looks right I'll circulate the test-case list and a simple rubric so your PMs can see how we'll score each axis (latency, relevance, integration completeness).

Looking forward — cc'd the engineering and security owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole
